_readme: Editable starter recipe collection. Each ingredient links to a food in sample-foods.json by key ('food'), with a quantity and unit (g, ml, cup, tbsp, tsp, or a serving key such as 'large', 'medium', 'slice', 'clove', 'piece'). Use "food": null and "qty": null for 'to taste' items that are not counted. Nutrition is calculated from the linked foods; it is never typed in here. Re-run `npm run db:seed` after editing (recipes are matched by 'key').

recipes.name: Overnight oats with blueberries
instructions: Stir the oats, milk and chia seeds together in a jar.
Cover and refrigerate overnight (or at least 4 hours).
Top with blueberries before eating.

recipes.name: Peanut butter banana oatmeal
instructions: Simmer the oats in soy milk for 4–5 minutes, stirring.
Slice the banana on top and add the peanut butter.

recipes.name: Scrambled eggs with spinach on toast
instructions: Toast the bread.
Wilt the spinach in the oil over medium heat.
Add the beaten eggs and stir gently until just set.
Season and serve on the toast.

recipes.name: Greek yogurt parfait
instructions: Layer yogurt and sliced strawberries in a bowl or glass.
Top with chopped almonds and a drizzle of honey.

recipes.name: Tofu scramble with peppers
instructions: Soften the diced pepper in the oil for 3 minutes.
Crumble in the tofu with the spices and cook 5 minutes.
Stir in the spinach until wilted. Serve with toast.

recipes.name: Avocado toast with tomato
instructions: Toast the bread.
Mash the avocado with lemon juice and spread on the toast.
Top with sliced tomato.

recipes.name: Cottage cheese, apple and walnut bowl
instructions: Dice the apple.
Spoon cottage cheese into a bowl and top with apple and walnuts.

recipes.name: Mushroom and pepper omelette
instructions: Cook the mushrooms and pepper in the oil until soft.
Pour in the beaten eggs, cook until nearly set, add cheese and fold.
Serve with toast.

recipes.name: Chia pudding with strawberries
instructions: Whisk chia seeds into soy milk.
Rest 10 minutes, whisk again, then chill overnight.
Top with strawberries.

recipes.name: Peanut butter and banana toast
instructions: Toast the bread and spread with peanut butter.
Top with sliced banana.

recipes.name: Hummus, cucumber and tomato pita
instructions: Warm the pita.
Spread hummus inside and fill with sliced cucumber and tomato.

recipes.name: Apple and walnut porridge
instructions: Simmer oats in soy milk with grated apple for 5 minutes.
Top with walnuts and cinnamon.

recipes.name: Chickpea and quinoa salad
instructions: Combine cooked quinoa, chickpeas, diced cucumber and tomato.
Dress with olive oil and lemon juice. Keeps 2 days chilled.

recipes.name: Tuna and black bean salad
instructions: Toss drained tuna, beans and diced pepper.
Serve over lettuce with oil and lemon.

recipes.name: Chicken and avocado tortillas
instructions: Cook the chicken in a pan for 6–7 minutes per side until cooked through; slice.
Warm tortillas and fill with chicken, avocado, lettuce and tomato.

recipes.name: Lentil and vegetable soup
instructions: Soften onion, carrot and garlic in oil for 8 minutes.
Add chopped tomato, lentils and water to cover; simmer 15 minutes.
Blend part of the soup for a thicker texture if you like.
Serve each bowl with a slice of bread.

recipes.name: Hummus and crunchy vegetable pita
instructions: Spread hummus in the pita.
Fill with grated carrot, sliced cucumber and lettuce.

recipes.name: Greek salad with feta and chickpeas
instructions: Chop the vegetables.
Toss with chickpeas and olive oil; crumble feta on top.

recipes.name: Black bean and rice bowl
instructions: Warm rice and beans.
Top with diced pepper, tomato and avocado.

recipes.name: Egg salad sandwich
instructions: Hard-boil the eggs (10 minutes), cool and chop.
Mix with yogurt; season.
Fill the bread with egg salad and lettuce.

recipes.name: Salmon, quinoa and broccoli bowl
instructions: Bake salmon at 200 °C / 400 °F for 12–15 minutes until it flakes easily.
Steam broccoli for 4 minutes.
Serve over quinoa with soy sauce.

recipes.name: Tofu and vegetable stir-fry with rice
instructions: Brown cubed tofu in the oil.
Add vegetables and stir-fry 4–5 minutes.
Add soy sauce and serve over rice.

recipes.name: Chicken, sweet potato and broccoli tray bake
instructions: Heat oven to 200 °C / 400 °F.
Toss cubed sweet potato with half the oil; roast 10 minutes.
Add chicken, broccoli, garlic and remaining oil; roast 20 minutes until the chicken is cooked through.

recipes.name: Spaghetti with beef and tomato sauce
instructions: Cook the pasta.
Brown the beef with onion and garlic in the oil.
Add chopped tomatoes and simmer 15 minutes.
Toss with the pasta.

recipes.name: Baked salmon with potato and spinach
instructions: Bake the potato (or microwave 6–8 minutes).
Bake salmon at 200 °C / 400 °F for 12–15 minutes.
Wilt spinach in the oil; finish with lemon.

recipes.name: Lentil and spinach curry with rice
instructions: Soften onion and garlic in oil; add spices for 1 minute.
Add tomatoes and lentils; simmer 15 minutes.
Stir in spinach. Serve with rice.

recipes.name: Black bean tacos with cheddar
instructions: Warm beans and tortillas.
Fill with beans, lettuce, tomato, cheese and avocado.

recipes.name: Shrimp and vegetable stir-fry with rice
instructions: Stir-fry vegetables in the oil for 3 minutes.
Add shrimp and cook until pink and opaque, 3–4 minutes.
Add soy sauce; serve with rice.

recipes.name: Chickpea and spinach stew with quinoa
instructions: Soften onion and garlic in oil.
Add tomatoes and chickpeas; simmer 12 minutes.
Stir in spinach. Serve over quinoa.

recipes.name: Beef and broccoli rice bowl
instructions: Brown the beef with garlic.
Add broccoli and a splash of water; cover 3 minutes.
Add soy sauce and serve over rice.

recipes.name: Vegetable pasta with peas and feta
instructions: Cook pasta, adding peas for the last 3 minutes.
Sauté zucchini and mushrooms in the oil.
Toss together and crumble over the feta.

recipes.name: Baked potato with black beans and avocado
instructions: Microwave the potato 6–8 minutes (or bake 45 minutes).
Split and fill with warm beans, spinach, tomato and avocado.

recipes.name: Peanut tofu noodles
instructions: Cook the noodles; add broccoli for the last 2 minutes.
Brown the tofu.
Whisk peanut butter, soy sauce and a little hot water; toss everything with grated carrot.
